Color
None: this wall always blocks, same as ever. Pick a color and it only blocks while nothing of that color is currently on — a matching Switch over in Fixtures, or a plate over in Objects, is what turns it off.
Paint
Pure decoration, zero gameplay meaning. Pick one to paint, or hit + to draw a new one — it's added to this project's kit, never swapped in for an old one.
